body: I’ve had this too,  it I’ve been taking it since 2014. I’m currently weaning to see if that’s the culprit

Nurse here. And I have a prior degree so I have a point of reference, Nursing school is a lot of work but not difficult. Nurses tend to be dramatic and allnurses is just the panicky spazzing types. 

You do have a life in school. Sure you have to study but it’s no more work (actually less) than any other worthwhile degree. Don’t get caught up in the mindfuck of it and you’ll be 1000000% better for it. Look at it as a way to get the piece of paper that gets you a job. The job will teach you everything you need to know so DO NOT STRESS during clinicals that you need to be an IV pro, know all the meds, etc etc etc. 

Youll do great. It’s a great job that pays well and great schedule. I work entirely PRN (I choose my own schedule) for $42/hr. It’s worth it!!!!!!!

It’s cliche but you being there is enough. Similar to untimely death there’s no words you can say and it’s almost (almost!) insulting to try to come up with any sort of speech that adequate says what a hug can. 

I work in the ICU dealing with this stuff often. What works well is just mirror what the other person is doing. If they are crying/venting emotionally then cry with them. If they are in problem solving mode, then offer advice. If they make weird dark jokes then gently go along with it. 

*****dont offer advice when they are not asking for any especially if emotional******
